title: 3×3 Cofactor Expansion
description: Fill-in-the-blank practice with the cofactor expansion pattern for 3×3 determinants (Anton §2.1): the signed coefficient at each position, and the submatrix the cross-out method leaves behind.

The blank pairs with the middle entry, -4 (row 1, column 2) — the cross-out method says: cover row 1 and column 2, and what's left is the submatrix Det{{4,-5},{2,-1}}. Full check: -1(-19) + (4)(6) + 0(-8) = 43.
